content: The Kingpin Bowling Alley safe code in Grand Theft Auto 6 is, frustratingly, not actually in the bowling alley itself. No, to get your hands on it legitimately, you need to ransack a different Kolt & Associates illegal operation, which essentially acts as the gang's headquarters, and has multiple safe codes available at once. But that doesn't help when you're deep in the back offices of the bowling alley, and you're being shot at by dozens of angry gang members.
